svg.title: Capacity and memory pressure
svg.desc: Variable: UMBRA_ACTIVE, Default: 32, Valid range: 1–256, Meaning: Concurrent active non-coordinator jobs; Variable: UMBRA_PENDING, Default: 256, Valid range: 1–4096, Meaning: Total admitted running/queued jobs; Variable: UMBRA_TABS, Default: 128, Valid range: 1–1024, Meaning: Admitted tabs, including scratch tabs/pop-ups; Variable: UMBRA_MIN_AVAILABLE_MB, Default: 512, Valid range: 0–16384, Meaning: Estimated system memory headroom reserved before starting more work; Variable: UMBRA_JOB_MB, Default: 128, Valid range: 1–4096, Meaning: Headroom estimate per active job; limits admission, not an allocation guarantee; Variable: UMBRA_CONNECTIONS, Default: 64, Valid range: 2–1024, Meaning: Accepted Unix-socket connections; Variable: UMBRA_QUEUE_BYTES, Default: 33554432, Valid range: 1024–268435456, Meaning: Admitted argument bytes; Variable: UMBRA_REQUEST_BYTES, Default: 8388608, Valid range: 1024–67108864, Meaning: Buffered unread socket input bytes
